message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on a stainless steel cab skirt with LED lighting for a truck (tractor). Cab skirts are body parts of heavy trucks, so they fall under heading 8708, parts and accessories of motor vehicles. Subheading 8708.29 covers other parts and accessories of bodies, and 8708.29.5160 is "Other" within it.

The alternative is 8512 (lighting equipment), but the lighting is decorative and not a signaling function. The essential character is the body part, so 8708 applies.

The 8708.29 breakdown is:
- 8708.29.10 – Stamped parts
- 8708.29.21 – Door assemblies...
- 8708.29.25 – Parts of door assemblies
- 8708.29.50 – Other: 8708.29.5060 (Other), 8708.29.5160 and the like
- 8708.29.5160 – Other

Recent ruling lists for similar items (e.g., truck cab panels) often give 8708.29.5160. I'll use that.
